bullets.title: Motherless Brooklyn
bullets.note: For literally 20 years, I’ve wanted [this book](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/75u8wd0mmu8h98pe0um/l8fehmh4e264km/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYW1hem9uLmNvbS9Nb3RoZXJsZXNzLUJyb29rbHluLUpvbmF0aGFuLUxldGhlbS9kcC8wMzc1NzI0ODM0Lw==) made into a movie. [Edward Norton](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/75u8wd0mmu8h98pe0um/o9tkhqhnp9gnr7/aHR0cHM6Ly90aW0uYmxvZy8yMDE5LzEwLzMxL2Vkd2FyZC1ub3J0b24tbW90aGVybGVzcy1icm9va2x5bi8_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1jb252ZXJ0a2l0JnV0bV9tZWRpdW09Y29udmVydGtpdCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249NS1iZg==) ([@EdwardNorton](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/75u8wd0mmu8h98pe0um/nncohvhgmq6g30/aHR0cDovL3R3aXR0ZXIuY29tL0Vkd2FyZE5vcnRvbg==)) and a star-studded cast—finally!—completely knocked it out of the park. Teaser: it’s a film noir detective story involving a lead character with both Tourette syndrome and OCD. Legendary documentary filmmaker [Ken Burns](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/75u8wd0mmu8h98pe0um/8nsqhoh3zdq3lr/aHR0cHM6Ly90aW0uYmxvZy8yMDE5LzA5LzEyL2tlbi1idXJucy8_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1jb252ZXJ0a2l0JnV0bV9tZWRpdW09Y29udmVydGtpdCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249NWJm) recently [called Edward’s _Motherless Brooklyn_ “nothing less than a modern masterpiece.”](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/75u8wd0mmu8h98pe0um/mga7h5h9v5m98x/aHR0cHM6Ly9tZWRpdW0uY29tL0BrZW5idXJuc3VudW0vbW90aGVybGVzcy1icm9va2x5bi04NWU2Zjc5Yjc0Mw==) The soundtrack alone makes this worth seeing on the big screen with a big sound system. Trust me.

bullets.title: Amolliar Mason Jar Foaming Soap Dispenser
bullets.note: with** [**unscented Dr. Bronner’s soap**](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/75u8wd0mmu8h98pe0um/46fvheh9vl69m6/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYW1hem9uLmNvbS9ncC9wcm9kdWN0L0IwMDBIS1BWOEUvcmVmPXBweF95b19kdF9iX2FzaW5fdGl0bGVfbzAwX3MwMD9pZT1VVEY4JnBzYz0x)**.** For the last few months, especially after a conversation with [Tony Fadell](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/75u8wd0mmu8h98pe0um/83tqhoh3zdq3ow/aHR0cHM6Ly9lbi53aWtpcGVkaWEub3JnL3dpa2kvVG9ueV9GYWRlbGw=) (coming soon), I’ve tried to reduce single-use plastic. If you combine this Mason jar gadget with some Dr. Bronner’s soap in a 1:5 soap-to-water ratio, it has the added benefit of lasting nearly _forever_. It saves a lot of shopping hassle, saves a ton on cost, and it produces far less waste. I’m really digging it and am replacing all hand soap in the house with this setup.
